name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-orphan-tool-call-guard
description: Orphan tool-call guard for dsh: a recorded tool call whose result was never durably recorded (a throwing tool scheduler `prepare`, a rejected dispatch, a cancelled turn) leaves an assistant tool_calls block the provider refuses on every later request, permanently poisoning the session. Mounted on the documented `llm/stream` waterfall, this plugin supplies the missing tool result to the outgoing request in `repair.ts`'s own synthetic shape, so the session is usable again — without writing a synthetic result into a log whose package-owned runtime invariant forbids exactly that write. Source: discussion #7129. Compatible with the dsh 0.1.2, 0.1.3, 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 prerelease lines.
